name: Position Initialization via NeRF Tri-Plane
definition: A method to initialize Gaussian positions using geometric information from a pre-trained 3D GAN's NeRF renderer, avoiding the need for iterative pruning/cloning during decoder training.
summary: Position Initialization via NeRF Tri-Plane initializes 3D Gaussian positions using NeRF opacity from tri-plane features, avoiding iterative pruning by leveraging pre-trained generative geometry.
